title: orchis rectiflorus
intro: Orchis rectiflorus, commonly known as the yellow helleborine, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The health benefits of Orchis rectiflorus include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and possess anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, sedative, and diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Orchis rectiflorus include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
